t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Some gnomes from certain colour groups start by collecting high value mushrooms and then drop after a certain amount of rounds . after the 4 round certain colour gnomes will progressively collect more mushrooms at a higher value , but this will cause other colour group gnomes to not collect or drop in value of points this will occur every 4 rounds or so .

vb_textbox.text: Certain coloured gnomes start to give higher amounts at the beginning of the game along with the respective multiplier so keep the colour in the back of your mind . however the only seem to collect more mushrooms when they are matched with certain opponent coloured gnomes . Also i kind of noticed it also depends on the multiplier that is offered ,for example if the red gnome is next to the yellow gnome and the multiplier is x5 the red gnome collects a good amount of mushrooms , but if the red gnome is matched with a yellow gnome with a x1 multiplier then the yellow gnome will be the victor . Try to form a strategy where you can find out where (colour) and when (multiplier) will be more beneficial .
